title: User Interview: Temporal Amnesia
questions: Take me back to the exact moment you realized you couldn't find the photo. What were you thinking?
How do you usually try to pinpoint the date of a memory? What 'anchors' do you use (like seasons, holidays, etc.)?
When that failed, what was your backup strategy?
How did this specific memory failure impact what you were trying to do next?
If the app could understand one thing about how you remember this event, what would it be?
what_to_watch_for: Look for signs of frustration or self-blame. Note the exact vocabulary they use when they hit a dead end.
